verdict.rationale: Raygun's evidence covers crash reporting, error grouping, AI-powered resolution, and RUM, but nothing describes an end-user-facing feedback dialog/widget that lets a user submit comments attached to the specific crash event they experienced. This is a distinct capability (like Sentry's User Feedback widget) not mentioned anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: any documentation of an end-user feedback widget or crash dialog, API/SDK for attaching user comments to error events, evidence of correlation between feedback and specific crash instances.
